name: Gram Silver
oneLiner: GRAMS is Token Teknoloji's gram-silver stablecoin from Turkey, backed by one gram of physical silver per token held at Turkish bank custodians.
collateral: One gram of physical silver per GRAMS, with Token Teknoloji proof pages listing silver held at Kuveyt Türk, VakıfBank, Ziraat Participation, and Akbank

mintAuthority.summary: GRAMS uses direct, immutable StableCoin deployments on Avalanche and Polygon. On Avalanche, EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb is both owner and supply manager. On Polygon, EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 is both owner and supply manager, while the Avalanche EOA is the live proposed owner and can claim ownership immediately. Each current owner or supply manager can mint without an on-chain supply cap.

controls.label: GRAMS Avalanche supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90233120, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb, proposedOwner() was zero, and eth_getCode on the authority returned 0x. Verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 and eth_getCode returned 0x. controls.label: GRAMS Polygon pending-owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, proposedOwner() returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb. Verified Claimable ownership lets this EOA call claimOwnership without another current-owner action, after which owner() can mint or replace the supply manager immediately. eth_getCode returned 0x.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 90233120 and Polygon block 90179923, both GRAMS deployments were direct contracts with zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. Their runtime hashes matched at 0xbca4ec7b5fa1440fe362bf2f1d259e720f28c06eaa61d832bcc2955d24cb51ce. Avalanche owner and supply manager were EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb. Polygon owner and supply manager were EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077, with the Avalanche EOA staged as proposed owner. Verified source permits each current owner or supply manager to mint uncapped supply and permits the proposed owner to claim Polygon ownership without delay.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GRAMS moves cross-chain through an issuer-operated burn/mint mechanism built into its own StableCoin contract: externalTransfer() routes tokens to the supply manager and burns them on the source chain, and externalTransferFrom() mints on the destination, both restricted to the issuer's onlySupplyManager role plus whenNotPaused and KYC/freeze compliance controls. There is no third-party bridge protocol (no LayerZero/OFT, Axelar ITS, Hyperlane, or Wormhole/NTT) and the identical multichain address reflects the same custom issuer contract (shared with Token Teknoloji's USDOT/EUROT/TRYT family), not an omnichain standard. The durable cross-chain supply path is issuer-native burn-mint.
